items.title: Craft Ammo at a Workbench
items.detail: Build a Tinker's Workbench in your C.A.M.P. or use one at the Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Build a Trap in a Workshop or C.A.M.P.
items.detail: Place any trap in your C.A.M.P. from the Defense build menu; a Punji Board is a cheap option.

items.title: Collect Soap
items.detail: Find soap at the Whitespring Resort bathrooms or collect from a Whitespring Robo Butler Collectron.

items.title: Craft or Scrap a Melee Weapon
items.detail: Craft or scrap any melee weapon at a workbench; try the Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Deal a Critical Hit to a Radtoad in VATS
items.detail: Head to Grafton by the toxic river and use V.A.T.S. to crit a Radtoad's head.

items.title: Eat a box of Sugar Bombs
items.detail: Find Sugar Bombs at New River Gorge Bridge - West or collect from a Santatron Collectron.

items.title: Take a Camera Picture of a Super Mutant
items.detail: Fast travel to West Tek Research Center with a camera equipped and photograph a Super Mutant.

items.title: Complete a Gold Star Daily Challenge!
items.detail: Earn the daily Gold Star on three separate days during the week by completing all six other dailies.

items.title: Collect a Fuel Tank or Gas Canister
items.detail: Find Fuel Tanks or Gas Canisters at industrial locations like Toxic Larry's Meat 'n Go or Grafton Steel.

items.title: Complete a Daily Operation!
items.detail: Join or start a Daily Ops public team and complete a Daily Operation; easier with a team.

items.title: Craft any Plushie at a Tinkerer's Bench
items.detail: Build a Tinkerer's Workbench in your C.A.M.P. or use the one at the Whitespring Resort.

items.title: Cripple a Spooky Scorched's Leg
items.detail: Spooky Scorched appear during the seasonal event; aim at their leg with a rifle using V.A.T.S.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Grape
items.detail: Get Nuka-Grape from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P. and drink it.

items.title: Drink Nuka-Orange
items.detail: Get Nuka-Orange from a Nuka-Cola Collectron Station in a C.A.M.P. and drink it.

items.title: Kill a Creature
items.detail: Fast travel to the Whitespring Golf Club where Feral Ghouls spawn; they're easy to take down.

items.title: Kill a Creature while Wearing a Costume
items.detail: Equip any costume item and kill creatures at Poseidon Energy Plant.

items.title: Take a Chem
items.detail: Get Chems from the Doctor's Orders Cigarette Machine in a C.A.M.P. or another player's C.A.M.P.

events.name: Spooky Scorched
events.description: Spooky Scorched enemies spawn throughout the world with a chance to drop Mystery Candy and unique Halloween-themed rewards.

events.name: Seasonal Fish Run Weekend
events.description: Increased chance to catch seasonal fish during this weekend event.

events.name: Minerva (List 7)
events.description: Minerva offers limited-time plans and items for sale using Gold Bullion.

events.name: Double SCORE and Caps-A-Plenty
events.description: Earn double SCORE and caps during this special event weekend.

events.name: Anniversary Events
events.description: Fallout 76 anniversary celebration with special events and rewards.
